verses.sloka: ते तु ताम् रजनीम् उष्य ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः ।उपतस्थुर् उपस्थानम् सह राज पुरोहिताः ॥२-१५-१॥
verses.transliteration: te tu tām rajanīm uṣya brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ ।upatasthur upasthānam saha rāja purohitāḥ ॥2-15-1॥

translations.english: The brahmins wellversed in the Vedas stayed waiting all night and assembled at the pavilion (for the consecration ceremony) along with royal priests.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर चौथी और पाँचवीं दो ड्योढ़ियाँ उन्होंने पैदल पारं कीं । इस प्रकार राजभवन की सब ड्योढियाँ लाँघ और साथ के १ वघमानणहैः-क्रीडाणहैः । ( रा०.) अप ॥ सुगा २०७ लोगों को अन्तिम ड्योढी पर छोड़ कर, दशरथनन्दन ने महाराज के अन्तःपुर में प्रवेश किया

verses.sloka: अमात्या बल मुख्याः च मुख्या ये निगमस्य च ।राघवस्य अभिषेक अर्थे प्रीयमाणाः तु सम्गताः ॥२-१५-२॥
verses.transliteration: amātyā bala mukhyāḥ ca mukhyā ye nigamasya ca ।rāghavasya abhiṣeka arthe prīyamāṇāḥ tu samgatāḥ ॥2-15-2॥

translations.english: For the consecration of the scion of the Raghu race (Rama), ministers, army chiefs and chiefs of merchants' associations assembled, brimming with joy.

verses.sloka: उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये च अभ्यागते अहनि ।अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विज इन्द्रैः उपकल्पितम् ॥२-१५-३॥
verses.transliteration: udite vimale sūrye puṣye ca abhyāgate ahani ।abhiṣekāya rāmasya dvija indraiḥ upakalpitam ॥2-15-3॥

translations.english: The best of brahmins had decided to perform the consecration ceremony after the bright Sun appeared in the sky when the Pushya star approached the karkataka lagna, which was the constellation at the time of Rama's birth.

verses.sloka: कान्चना जल कुम्भाः च भद्र पीठम् स्वलम्क्Rतम् ।काञ्चना जलकुमाभश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलङ्कृतम् ॥२-१५-४॥
verses.transliteration: kāncanā jala kumbhāḥ ca bhadra pīṭham svalamkRtam ।kāñcanā jalakumābhaśca bhadrapīṭhaṁ svalaṅkṛtam ॥2-15-4॥

translations.english: Golden jars filled with water, the welldecorated throne and a chariot spread well with bright tigerskin (were kept ready).

verses.sloka: रथश्च सम्यगा स्तीर्णोभास्वता व्याग्रचर्मणा ।गङ्गायमुनयोः पुण्यात्सङ्गमादाहृतं जलम् ॥२-१५-५॥
verses.transliteration: rathaśca samyagā stīrṇobhāsvatā vyāgracarmaṇā ।gaṅgāyamunayoḥ puṇyātsaṅgamādāhṛtaṁ jalam ॥2-15-5॥

translations.english: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.

verses.sloka: याश्चान्याः सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपाः सरांसि च ।प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहा स्समाहिताः ॥२-१५-६॥
verses.transliteration: yāścānyāḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṁsi ca ।prāgvāhāścordhvavāhāśca tiryagvāhā ssamāhitāḥ ॥2-15-6॥

translations.english: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.

verses.sloka: ताभ्यश्चैवाहृतं तो यं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः ।सलाजाः क्षीरिभिश्छन्ना घटाः काञ्चनराजताः ॥२-१५-७॥
verses.transliteration: tābhyaścaivāhṛtaṁ to yaṁ samudrebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ ।salājāḥ kṣīribhiśchannā ghaṭāḥ kāñcanarājatāḥ ॥2-15-7॥

translations.english: Gold and silver vessels filled with holy water and puffed corn, adorned with lotuses, water lilies and leaves from trees rich in sap shone.

verses.sloka: पद्मोत्पलयुता भान्ति पूर्णाः परमवारिणा ।क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः ॥२-१५-८॥
verses.transliteration: padmotpalayutā bhānti pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā ।kṣaudraṁ dadhi ghṛtaṁ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ ॥2-15-8॥

translations.english: Honey, curd, ghee, puffed grain, darbha grass, flowers and milk were arranged. Wellmannered courtesans adorned with all kinds of ornaments (stood in position).

verses.sloka: वेश्याश्चैव शुभाचाराः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः ।चन्द्रांशुविकचप्रख्यं काञ्चनं रत्नभुषितम् ॥२-१५-९॥
verses.transliteration: veśyāścaiva śubhācārāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।candrāṁśuvikacaprakhyaṁ kāñcanaṁ ratnabhuṣitam ॥2-15-9॥

translations.english: An excellent fan of yak's tail with a staff of gold studded with gems looking like diffused moonbeams was kept ready.

verses.sloka: सज्जं तिष्ठति रामस्य वालव्यजनमुत्तमम् ।चन्द्रमण्डलसम्काशमातपत्रं च पाण्डुरम् ॥२-१५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sajjaṁ tiṣṭhati rāmasya vālavyajanamuttamam ।candramaṇḍalasamkāśamātapatraṁ ca pāṇḍuram ॥2-15-10॥

translations.english: A lustrous pale white umbrella resembling the Moon's orb or the pole star was kept in front of the coronation pavilion.

verses.sloka: सज्जं द्युतिकरं श्रीमदभिषेकपुरस्कृतम् ।पाण्डुरश्च वृषः सज्जः पाण्डुरोऽस्वश्च सुस्थितः ॥२-१५-११॥
verses.transliteration: sajjaṁ dyutikaraṁ śrīmadabhiṣekapuraskṛtam ।pāṇḍuraśca vṛṣaḥ sajjaḥ pāṇḍuro'svaśca susthitaḥ ॥2-15-11॥

translations.english: A bull and a horse both pale white and a majestic elephant in rut worthy of royal ride stood waiting.

verses.sloka: प्रसृतश्च गजः श्रीमानौपवाह्यः प्रतीक्षते ।अष्टौ च कन्या माङ्गल्याः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः ॥२-१५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: prasṛtaśca gajaḥ śrīmānaupavāhyaḥ pratīkṣate ।aṣṭau ca kanyā māṅgalyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ॥2-15-12॥

translations.english: Eight auspicious maidens adorned with all types of ornaments, all sorts of musical instruments, panegyrists and others (were in waiting).

verses.sloka: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि वन्दिनश्च तथापरे ।इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम् ॥२-१५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi vandinaśca tathāpare ।ikṣvākūṇāṁ yathā rājye saṁbhriyetābhiṣecanam ॥2-15-13॥

translations.english: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

verses.sloka: तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचन्म् ।ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेता महीपतिम् ॥२-१५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tathājātīyamādāya rājaputrābhiṣecanm ।te rājavacanāttatra samavetā mahīpatim ॥2-15-14॥

translations.english: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

verses.sloka: अपश्यन्तोऽब्रुवन् को बु राज्ञोनः प्रतिपादयेत् ।न पश्यामश्च राजानमुदितश्च दिवाकरः ॥२-१५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: apaśyanto'bruvan ko bu rājñonaḥ pratipādayet ।na paśyāmaśca rājānamuditaśca divākaraḥ ॥2-15-15॥

translations.english: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

verses.sloka: यौवराज्याभिषेकश्च सज्जो रामस्य धीमतः ।इति तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु सार्वभौमान् महीपतीन् ॥२-१५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: yauvarājyābhiṣekaśca sajjo rāmasya dhīmataḥ ।iti teṣu bruvāṇeṣu sārvabhaumān mahīpatīn ॥2-15-16॥

translations.english: While the sovereign monarchs who hailed from different parts of the earth were thus talking Sumantra the king's confidant said:

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत्तानिदं सर्वान्सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः ।रामः च सम्यग् आस्तीर्णो भास्वरा व्याघ्र चर्मणा ॥२-१५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: abravīttānidaṁ sarvānsumantro rājasatkṛtaḥ ।rāmaḥ ca samyag āstīrṇo bhāsvarā vyāghra carmaṇā ॥2-15-17॥

translations.english: In obedience to the king's command I am hurrying for Rama. All of you are honourable to king Dasaratha, especially to Rama.

verses.sloka: गन्गा यमुनयोह् पुण्यात् सम्गमात् आह्Rतम् जलम् ।अयं पृच्छामि वचनात् सुखमायुष्मतामहम् ॥२-१५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: gangā yamunayoh puṇyāt samgamāt āhRtam jalam ।ayaṁ pṛcchāmi vacanāt sukhamāyuṣmatāmaham ॥2-15-18॥

translations.english: On your behalf I shall enquire from the king who is awake now about his welfare and the reason for calling me here.

verses.sloka: राज्ञः संप्रतिबुद्धस्य चानागमनकारणम् ।इत्युक्त्वान्तःपुरद्वारमाजगाम पुराणवित् ॥२-१५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ saṁpratibuddhasya cānāgamanakāraṇam ।ityuktvāntaḥpuradvāramājagāma purāṇavit ॥2-15-19॥

translations.english: Having said so, Sumantra who was versed in history and tradition approached the inner apartment which always remains closed.

verses.sloka: सदासक्तं च तद्वेश्म सुमन्त्रः प्रविवेश ह ।तुष्टावास्य तदा वंशं प्रविश्य स विशां पतेः ॥२-१५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sadāsaktaṁ ca tadveśma sumantraḥ praviveśa ha ।tuṣṭāvāsya tadā vaṁśaṁ praviśya sa viśāṁ pateḥ ॥2-15-20॥

translations.english: Entering the king's inner apartment, he began extoling the virtues of the royal dynasty, and stood there as he approached the king's bedchamber.

verses.sloka: शयनीयं नरेन्ध्रस्य तदसाद्य व्यतिष्ठत ।सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करिणि मन्त्रा ॥२-१५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: śayanīyaṁ narendhrasya tadasādya vyatiṣṭhata ।so'tyāsādya tu tadveśma tiraskariṇi mantrā ॥2-15-21॥

translations.english: Having approached the king's bedchamber Sumatra stood behind the screen, singing his glory and seeking the blessings (of God) on this son of Raghus dynasty.

verses.sloka: आशीर्भिर्गुणयुक्ताभिरभितुष्टाव राघवम् ।सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि ॥२-१५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: āśīrbhirguṇayuktābhirabhituṣṭāva rāghavam ।somasūryau ca kākutstha śivavaiśravaṇāvapi ॥2-15-22॥

translations.english: O scion of the kakutsthas (Dasaratha), may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra grant you victory
translations.hindi: इति सप्तदशः सर्ग; || तदनन्तर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के अपने पिता के पास चले जाने यर, सब लोग परमानन्दित हो, उनके लौटने की उसी प्रकार चाहना करने लगे, जिस प्रकार पूर्णिमा के चन्द्रमा के उद्य की समुद्र चाहना करता है

verses.sloka: वरुणश्चग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयम् प्रदिशन्तु ते ।गता भगवती रात्रिरः शिवमुपस्थितम् ॥२-१५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇaścagnirindraśca vijayam pradiśantu te ।gatā bhagavatī rātriraḥ śivamupasthitam ॥2-15-23॥

translations.english: The holy night has passed and the auspicious day has arrived. O tiger among kings, awaken and attend to your duties.

verses.sloka: बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम् ।ब्राह्मणा बलमुख्याश्च नैगमाश्चागता नृप ॥२-१५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: buddhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram ।brāhmaṇā balamukhyāśca naigamāścāgatā nṛpa ॥2-15-24॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu dynasty brahmins, army commanders and merchants have arrived and they beseech your audience. Please awake.

verses.sloka: दर्शनम् प्रतिकाङ्क्षन्ते प्रतिबुद्ध्यस्व राघव ।स्तुवन्तं तम् तदा सूतं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम् ॥२-१५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: darśanam pratikāṅkṣante pratibuddhyasva rāghava ।stuvantaṁ tam tadā sūtaṁ sumantraṁ mantrakovidam ॥2-15-25॥

translations.english: Dasaratha waking up saw the charioteer and expert counsellor Sumantra extoling him, and said:

verses.sloka: प्रतिबुद्ध्य ततो राजा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।राममानय सूतेति यदस्यभिहितो/अनया ॥२-१५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: pratibuddhya tato rājā idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।rāmamānaya sūteti yadasyabhihito/anayā ॥2-15-26॥

translations.english: You had been asked by her (Kaikeyi) to bring Rama here. What is the reason the command is disregarded?

verses.sloka: किमिदं कारणम् येन ममाज्ञा प्रतिहन्यते ।न चैव सम्प्रसुप्तोऽहमानयेहाशु राघवम् ॥२-१५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kimidaṁ kāraṇam yena mamājñā pratihanyate ।na caiva samprasupto'hamānayehāśu rāghavam ॥2-15-27॥

translations.english: I did not sleep (last night). Bring Rama here at once, said king Dasaratha to the charioteer again.

verses.sloka: इति राजा दशरथः सूतं तत्रान्वशात्पुनः ।स राजवचनं श्रुत्वा शिरसा प्रतिपूज्य तम् ॥२-१५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: iti rājā daśarathaḥ sūtaṁ tatrānvaśātpunaḥ ।sa rājavacanaṁ śrutvā śirasā pratipūjya tam ॥2-15-28॥

translations.english: At these words of the king, he offered his salutations by bowing his head and left the king's apartment, reflecting on the great happy event.

verses.sloka: निर्जगम नृपावासान्मन्यमानः प्रियं महत् ।प्रसन्नो राजमार्गं च पताकाध्वजशोभितम् ॥२-१५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: nirjagama nṛpāvāsānmanyamānaḥ priyaṁ mahat ।prasanno rājamārgaṁ ca patākādhvajaśobhitam ॥2-15-29॥

translations.english: The charioteer left cheerfully, happily looking at the highway bedecked with pennants and banners.

verses.sloka: हृष्टः प्रमुदितः सूतो जगामाशु विलोकयन् ।स सूतस्तत्र शुश्राव रामाधिकरणाः कथाः ॥२-१५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ pramuditaḥ sūto jagāmāśu vilokayan ।sa sūtastatra śuśrāva rāmādhikaraṇāḥ kathāḥ ॥2-15-30॥

translations.english: The charioteer heard the conversation relating to Rama and his consecration among the happy citizens.

verses.sloka: अभिषेचनसंयुक्तास्सर्वलोकस्य हृष्टवत् ।ततो ददर्श रुचिरं कैलासशिखरप्रभम् ॥२-१५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣecanasaṁyuktāssarvalokasya hṛṣṭavat ।tato dadarśa ruciraṁ kailāsaśikharaprabham ॥2-15-31॥

translations.english: Thereafter, Sumantra beheld the beautiful palace of Rama, resembling the abode of Indra or the peak of Kailasa in its splendour.

verses.sloka: रामवेश्म सुमन्त्रस्तु शक्रवेश्मसमप्रभम् ।महाकवाटपिहितं वितर्दिशतशोभितम् ॥२-१५-३२॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaveśma sumantrastu śakraveśmasamaprabham ।mahākavāṭapihitaṁ vitardiśataśobhitam ॥2-15-32॥

translations.english: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. The arches were studded with different gems and corals. Bright like dense autumnal cloud, it shone like the cave of mount Meru. It was ornamented with excellent garlands and precious diamonds. Pearls were strewn around. Decorated with sandal and aloe wood, it emitted, like the peak of mount Dardura, captivating fragrance৷৷ Sarasas and peacocks were singing sweetly. verses.sloka: काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रं मणिविद्रुमतोरणम् ।शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यं दीप्तं मेरुगुहोपमम् ॥२-१५-३३॥
verses.transliteration: kāñcanapratimaikāgraṁ maṇividrumatoraṇam ।śāradābhraghanaprakhyaṁ dīptaṁ meruguhopamam ॥2-15-33॥

verses.transliteration: maṇibhirvaramālyānāṁ sumahadbhiralaṁkṛtam ।muktāmaṇibhirākīrṇaṁ candhanāgurubhūṣitam ॥2-15-34॥

verses.transliteration: gandhānmanojñān visṛjaddhārduraṁ śikharaṁ yathā ।sārasaiśca mayūraiśca vinadadbhirvirājitam ॥2-15-35॥

verses.sloka: सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णं सुकीर्णं भक्तिभिस्तथा ।मन्श्चक्षुश्च भूतानामाददत्तिग्मतेजसा ॥२-१५-३६॥
verses.transliteration: sukṛtehāmṛgākīrṇaṁ sukīrṇaṁ bhaktibhistathā ।manścakṣuśca bhūtānāmādadattigmatejasā ॥2-15-36॥

verses.sloka: चन्द्रभास्करसंकाशम् कुबेरभवनोपमम् ।महेन्द्रधामप्रतिमं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम् ॥२-१५-३७॥
verses.transliteration: candrabhāskarasaṁkāśam kuberabhavanopamam ।mahendradhāmapratimaṁ nānāpakṣisamākulam ॥2-15-37॥

verses.sloka: मेरुशृङ्गसमम् सूतो रामवेश्म ददर्श ह ।उपस्थितैः समाकीर्णम् जनैरञ्जलिकारिभिः ॥२-१५-३८॥
verses.transliteration: meruśṛṅgasamam sūto rāmaveśma dadarśa ha ।upasthitaiḥ samākīrṇam janairañjalikāribhiḥ ॥2-15-38॥

verses.sloka: उपादाय समाक्रान्तैस्तथा जानपदैर्जनैः ।रामाभिषेकसुमुखैरुन्मुखैः समलम्कृतम् ॥२-१५-३९॥
verses.transliteration: upādāya samākrāntaistathā jānapadairjanaiḥ ।rāmābhiṣekasumukhairunmukhaiḥ samalamkṛtam ॥2-15-39॥

verses.sloka: महामेघसमप्रख्यमुदग्रं सुविभूषितम् ।नानारत्नसमाकीर्णं कुब्जकैरातकावृतम् ॥२-१५-४०॥
verses.transliteration: mahāmeghasamaprakhyamudagraṁ suvibhūṣitam ।nānāratnasamākīrṇaṁ kubjakairātakāvṛtam ॥2-15-40॥

translations.english: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. Lofty, it looked like a vast cloud. Welldecked and filled with various gems, it was crowded with hunchbacks and kiratas (hunters) too.

verses.sloka: स वाजियुक्तेन रथेन सारथि ।र्नराकुलं राजकुलम् विराजयन् ।वरूथिना रामगृहाभिपातिना ।पुरस्य सर्वस्य मनांसि हर्शयन् ॥२-१५-४१॥
verses.transliteration: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathi ।rnarākulaṁ rājakulam virājayan ।varūthinā rāmagṛhābhipātinā ।purasya sarvasya manāṁsi harśayan ॥2-15-41॥

translations.english: Mounted on a chariot, attached with a fender and driven by horses, the charioteer advanced towards the royal palace of Rama delighting the minds of the people of the city.

verses.sloka: ततस्समासाद्य महाधनं महत् ।प्रहृष्टरोमा स बभूव सारथिः ।मृगैर्मयूरैश्च समाकुलोल्बणं ।गृहं वरार्हस्य शचीपतेरिव ॥२-१५-४२॥
verses.transliteration: tatassamāsādya mahādhanaṁ mahat ।prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūva sārathiḥ ।mṛgairmayūraiśca samākulolbaṇaṁ ।gṛhaṁ varārhasya śacīpateriva ॥2-15-42॥

translations.english: Having reached the palace abounding in deer and peacocks which resembled the magnificent and opulent abode of Indra, the charioteer was thrilled at the allpervading beauty of the place befitting Rama.

verses.sloka: स तत्र कैलासनिभाः स्वलंकृताः ।प्रविश्य कक्ष्यास्त्रिदशालयोपमाः ।प्रियान् वरान् राममते स्थितान् बहून् ।व्यपोह्य शुद्धांतमुपस्थितो रथी ॥२-१५-४३॥
verses.transliteration: sa tatra kailāsanibhāḥ svalaṁkṛtāḥ ।praviśya kakṣyāstridaśālayopamāḥ ।priyān varān rāmamate sthitān bahūn ।vyapohya śuddhāṁtamupasthito rathī ॥2-15-43॥

translations.english: Having entered the welldecorated palace which was (lofty) like Kailasa, he crossed the courtyards comparable to the abode of the celestials, passed through the many bosom friends of Rama and entered the private apartment.

verses.sloka: स तत्र शुश्राव च हर्षयुक्ता ।रामाभिषेकार्थकृता जनानां ।नरेम्द्रसूनोरभिमंगLआर्थाः ।सर्वस्य लोकस्य गिरः प्रहृष्टः ॥२-१५-४४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tatra śuśrāva ca harṣayuktā ।rāmābhiṣekārthakṛtā janānāṁ ।naremdrasūnorabhimaṁgaLārthāḥ ।sarvasya lokasya giraḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ ॥2-15-44॥

translations.english: There he heard the happy words spoken by people about the enthronement of prince Rama and his future wellbeing.

verses.sloka: महेंद्रसद्मप्रतिमं तु वेश्म ।रामस्य रम्यं मृगमुच्चं ।विभ्राजमानं प्रभया सुमम्त्रः ॥२-१५-४५॥
verses.transliteration: maheṁdrasadmapratimaṁ tu veśma ।rāmasya ramyaṁ mṛgamuccaṁ ।vibhrājamānaṁ prabhayā sumamtraḥ ॥2-15-45॥

translations.english: Sumantra beheld Rama's palace which resembled the high summit of mount Meru shining with splendour. Filled with animals and birds, if looked like the abode of Indra.

verses.sloka: उपस्थितै रञ्जलिकारिभिश्च ।सोपायनैर्जानपदैर्जनैश्च ।कोट्या परार्धैश्च विमुक्तयानैः ।समाकुलं द्वारपदम् ददर्श ॥२-१५-४६॥
verses.transliteration: upasthitai rañjalikāribhiśca ।sopāyanairjānapadairjanaiśca ।koṭyā parārdhaiśca vimuktayānaiḥ ।samākulaṁ dvārapadam dadarśa ॥2-15-46॥

translations.english: He saw villagers and others in crores and parardhas, leaving their chariots and thronging the gateway, (some) paying obeisance with folded palms and (some) carrying gifts in their hands.

verses.sloka: ततो महामेघमहीधराभं ।प्रभिन्नमत्यङ्कुशमत्यसह्यम् ।रामोपवाह्याम् रुचिरम् ददर्श ।शत्रुम्जयं नागमुदग्रकायम् ॥२-१५-४७॥
verses.transliteration: tato mahāmeghamahīdharābhaṁ ।prabhinnamatyaṅkuśamatyasahyam ।rāmopavāhyām ruciram dadarśa ।śatrumjayaṁ nāgamudagrakāyam ॥2-15-47॥

translations.english: He beheld a beautiful elephant named Satrunjaya with a huge body on which Rama was to mount. It looked like a vast mountain or a huge cloud. With ichor flowing from his temples and without caring for the goad, the elephant was intolerant.

verses.sloka: स्वलंकृतान् सास्वरथान् सकुम्जरा ।नमात्यमुखयाम्श्च ददर्श वल्लभान् ।व्यपोह्य सूतः सहितान्समंततः ।समृद्धमंतःपुर माविवेश ह ॥२-१५-४८॥
verses.transliteration: svalaṁkṛtān sāsvarathān sakumjarā ।namātyamukhayāmśca dadarśa vallabhān ।vyapohya sūtaḥ sahitānsamaṁtataḥ ।samṛddhamaṁtaḥpura māviveśa ha ॥2-15-48॥

translations.english: Important ministers who were dear to the king and welladorned arrived there on their horses, chariots and elephants. Sumantra finding his way through the crowd of the people who assembled on all sides, entered the glorious private apartment of Rama.

verses.sloka: ततोऽद्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्नि भं ।महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम् ।अवार्यमाणः प्रविवेश सारथिः ।प्रभूतरत्नं मकरो यथार्णवम् ॥२-१५-४९॥
verses.transliteration: tato'drikūṭācalameghasanni bhaṁ ।mahāvimānopamaveśmasaṁyutam ।avāryamāṇaḥ praviveśa sārathiḥ ।prabhūtaratnaṁ makaro yathārṇavam ॥2-15-49॥

translations.english: The palace looked like a mountain peak covered by a cloud and a great vimana surrounded by splendid apartments. The charioteer entered the palace unobstructed like a crocodile entering the ocean bristling with many gems. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चदशःसर्गः।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
